items.title: Pay annual gas bill balance
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Private payment deadline counted under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB. Trigger event is the invoice date, 27.11.2026 (day of event not counted). Counting 30 calendar days: day 1 = 28.11.2026 ... day 3 = 30.11.2026, day 4 = 01.12.2026 ... day 30 = 27.12.2026. 27.12.2026 is a Sunday (four weeks after Sunday 29.11.2026, which is given as today). Since this is a payment deadline, § 193 BGB moves the end to the next working day for the payer's Land (NW): Monday 28.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NW.
